title: Wide & Deep Learning for Recommender Systems
summary: Jointly trains a wide linear model over cross-product features with a deep neural network over embeddings. The wide part memorizes frequent co-occurrences while the deep part generalizes to unseen feature combinations.
expected_effect: Improves generalization on sparse ID features while keeping memorization of frequent cross-features.

title: DeepFM: A Factorization-Machine based Neural Network for CTR Prediction
summary: Replaces the wide component of Wide&Deep with a factorization machine that shares embeddings with the deep component. Learns low- and high-order feature interactions end-to-end with no manual feature engineering.
expected_effect: Typically lifts AUC over LR/FM baselines by jointly learning 2nd-order and implicit high-order feature interactions.

title: xDeepFM: Combining Explicit and Implicit Feature Interactions for Recommender Systems
summary: Introduces a Compressed Interaction Network (CIN) that generates explicit, vector-wise, bounded-degree feature interactions, combined with a DNN for implicit interactions.
expected_effect: Explicit vector-wise high-order crosses improve AUC over DNN-only implicit interaction modeling.

title: Deep & Cross Network for Ad Click Predictions
summary: Adds a cross network that applies explicit feature crossing at each layer with a bounded polynomial degree, run alongside a standard DNN, adding negligible extra parameters.
expected_effect: Cheap explicit bounded-degree crosses improve AUC over a plain DNN at low added parameter cost.

title: DCN V2: Improved Deep & Cross Network and Practical Lessons for Web-scale Learning to Rank Systems
summary: Scales up the DCN cross layers with a more expressive matrix formulation and a mixture of low-rank experts, addressing the limited expressiveness of the original DCN at web scale.
expected_effect: Low-rank cross layers give a better accuracy/latency tradeoff than DCN v1 on large web-scale ranking traffic.

title: Deep Interest Network for Click-Through Rate Prediction
summary: Uses a local activation unit to adaptively attend over a user's historical behavior sequence with respect to a candidate ad, instead of squashing history into one fixed vector.
expected_effect: Target-aware attention over behavior history captures diverse user interest, improving CTR AUC over sum/mean pooling.

title: Deep Interest Evolution Network for Click-Through Rate Prediction
summary: Extends DIN with an interest extractor GRU layer and an attention-based interest evolving layer to model how user interest drifts over time relative to the target item.
expected_effect: Modeling interest evolution over the behavior sequence gives further CTR AUC gains on top of DIN-style attention.

title: Behavior Sequence Transformer for E-commerce Recommendation in Alibaba
summary: Applies a Transformer self-attention encoder over the user's behavior sequence to capture sequential signal, instead of just concatenating behavior features as prior CTR models did.
expected_effect: Self-attention over the full sequence captures dependencies an RNN/GRU encoder misses, improving CTR over feature-concat baselines.

title: AutoInt: Automatic Feature Interaction Learning via Self-Attentive Neural Networks
summary: Maps features into a low-dimensional space and applies multi-head self-attention with residual connections so stacked layers model increasingly higher-order feature combinations.
expected_effect: Self-attentive interaction layers learn arbitrary-order feature crosses without hand-picking interaction degree.

title: FiBiNET: Combining Feature Importance and Bilinear Feature Interaction for Click-Through Rate Prediction
summary: Uses a Squeeze-and-Excitation network to dynamically re-weight feature embeddings by importance, then applies bilinear functions instead of inner/Hadamard product for interaction.
expected_effect: Dynamic per-feature importance weighting plus bilinear interaction improves over fixed-weight feature crossing.

title: Product-based Neural Networks for User Response Prediction
summary: Inserts a product layer between the embedding layer and the fully-connected layers to explicitly capture pairwise interactive patterns across feature fields before the DNN.
expected_effect: Explicit pairwise product interactions before the MLP improve over plain embedding-concatenation MLP baselines.

title: Neural Factorization Machines for Sparse Predictive Analytics
summary: Introduces a Bilinear Interaction pooling layer that lets a single shallow hidden layer model second-order feature interactions, combining FM linearity with neural non-linearity.
expected_effect: Bilinear pooling lets a shallow MLP capture 2nd-order interactions with fewer parameters than a deep DNN-only model.

title: Modeling Task Relationships in Multi-task Learning with Multi-gate Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Replaces a shared-bottom multi-task network with multiple expert subnetworks and a per-task gating network, letting each task learn its own weighting over shared experts.
expected_effect: Per-task gates over shared experts reduce negative transfer between CTR and CVR heads versus a hard shared-bottom.

title: Progressive Layered Extraction (PLE): A Novel Multi-Task Learning (MTL) Model for Personalized Recommendations
summary: Separates task-shared experts from task-specific experts and stacks them with progressive routing layers, explicitly addressing negative transfer and the seesaw effect that MMoE still shows.
expected_effect: Separating shared/specific experts with progressive routing reduces seesaw effect and outperforms MMoE on multi-task CTR/CVR.

title: Entire Space Multi-Task Model: An Effective Approach for Estimating Post-Click Conversion Rate
summary: Trains CVR jointly with CTR via the CTCVR = CTR * CVR identity, estimated over the entire impression space, removing the sample selection bias from training CVR on clicked-only data.
expected_effect: Entire-space CTCVR training removes sample selection bias and data sparsity in CVR estimation versus a clicked-only CVR model.

title: Entire Space Multi-Task Modeling via Post-Click Behavior Decomposition for Conversion Rate Prediction
summary: Extends ESMM by decomposing post-click behavior into deterministic and other sub-actions along the impression-click-...-purchase path, giving denser auxiliary supervision for CVR.
expected_effect: Finer post-click sub-target decomposition gives denser supervision, further reducing CVR data sparsity beyond ESMM's two-task split.

title: Modeling the Sequential Dependence among Audience Multi-step Conversions with Multi-task Learning in Targeted Display Advertising
summary: Uses an Adaptive Information Transfer module to pass information forward between task towers along a multi-step conversion path (e.g. click to purchase), with a calibration loss enforcing monotonic decay.
expected_effect: Adaptive information transfer between sequential task towers improves calibration and AUC on multi-step conversion funnels.

title: One Model to Serve All: Star Topology Adaptive Recommender for Multi-Domain CTR Prediction
summary: Combines shared centered parameters with per-domain private parameters in a star topology, plus partitioned batch normalization, so one CTR model serves several business domains at once.
expected_effect: Shared-plus-domain-specific parameters let one model serve multiple domains without per-domain model duplication.

title: Deep Neural Networks for YouTube Recommendations
summary: Describes a two-stage candidate generation and ranking DNN pipeline, including example-age features and sampled-softmax negative sampling to correct for time-varying item popularity bias.
expected_effect: Example-age feature plus sampled-softmax negative sampling reduces popularity/time bias picked up during training.

title: Utilizing Non-click Samples via Semi-supervised Learning for Conversion Rate Prediction
summary: RecSys '24. Treats the 96% of AliCCP impressions that were never clicked as unlabeled data rather than discarding them, assigning pseudo-labels via semi-supervised learning to train CVR over the full impression space. Decouples the CTR and CVR heads, using CTR only as an auxiliary task to sharpen shared embeddings. Reported CVR AUC on AliCCP: 0.6498 (MLP), 0.6487 (DeepFM), 0.6520 (DCNv2), against ESMM at 0.628-0.631.
expected_effect: THIS IS THE OFFICIAL BASELINE TO BEAT. Reproduce it first, then improve on it; ESMM and MMoE both score well below it, so proposing them as improvements is a regression.

title: NISE ablation: non-click space subsampling (paper Section 5.7)
summary: The NISE authors' own ablation shows subsampling the unclicked impression space -- down to as little as 1/24 of it -- can raise CVR AUC rather than lower it, up to a point, while cutting training cost substantially. The unclicked rows dominate the 84M-row dataset, so this shrinks the per-epoch working set dramatically.
expected_effect: Cuts GPU-hours per iteration by roughly an order of magnitude while potentially improving CVR AUC. Highest value-per-unit-compute change available; try it early and sweep the sampling ratio.

title: ESCM2: Entire Space Counterfactual Multi-Task Model for Post-Click Conversion Rate Estimation
summary: Argues ESMM's entire-space formulation is still biased, and applies inverse propensity weighting and a doubly-robust estimator as counterfactual regularizers over the full impression space. Reported on AliCCP: IPS variant 0.6411, DR variant 0.6182 CVR AUC.
expected_effect: The IPS variant is the strongest non-NISE baseline on AliCCP; a useful component to combine with pseudo-labeling.

title: DCMT: A Direct Entire-Space Causal Multi-Task Framework for Post-Click Conversion Estimation
summary: Adds a counterfactual CVR tower constrained against the factual tower so that predicted conversion probabilities on clicked and unclicked items stay consistent. Reported 0.6407 CVR AUC on AliCCP.
expected_effect: Competitive with ESCM2-IPS; the counterfactual-consistency constraint is composable with other multi-task backbones.
